item.text: {"reviews":[{"benchmark":"arc","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"ARC-AGI-2, the public test set and official scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The passage describes learning rules from examples, the AI systems assessed and intended comparisons."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Worked grid pairs, new inputs and the required exact output grids are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Two attempts, verified-test settings and spending limits are described; other testing routes may use different conditions."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact grid matching, averaging within problems and averaging problem scores are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring rules from examples is linked to reasoning with little specialist knowledge."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Puzzle origins, human difficulty studies and duplicate-rule screening are described; broader representativeness is not established."},{"id":8,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Developer review, human solving and documented corrections show that problems and expected outputs were checked."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The puzzles exercise rule inference, but evidence covers two-dimensional grids rather than the broader intelligence claims."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact matching measures successful grid completion, but gives no credit for a nearly correct grid."},{"id":11,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The averaging procedure is explicit, but support for its interpretation as a broader ability measure is limited."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public marking tests cover correct grids, wrong sizes, changed squares and missing outputs; whole-system validation remains limited."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"AI scores and human difficulty results provide context, but the human study covered a larger pool than the final test."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Verified evaluations use one run; no repeated-run study measuring AI score variation is supplied."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of changes to instructions, grid presentation or software is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The reviewed materials provide no estimates or ranges for repeated-test score variation."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developers addressed program-search shortcuts and repeated rules, but did not establish coverage of every shortcut."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-test handling agreements and exposure monitoring address some risks; public problems remain accessible."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Development training is allowed, evaluation-specific tuning is discouraged and verified testing is not offered for iterative feedback."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No supplied study connects scores to language, social interaction or other real-world performance."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified evaluations record settings and test sets were matched for human difficulty; other testing routes may differ."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public problems, software and marking tests support inspection, while hidden problems have controlled access."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public licensing and hidden-data confidentiality, provider-handling and selected-submission review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated problem and code changes are recorded, but affected AI scores are not all recalculated."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid reasoning claims have direct support; broader intelligence connections remain unvalidated in the supplied studies."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire separates documented grid-solving performance from broader reasoning claims. Items about testing require distinguishing tests that occurred from evidence that validation was comprehensive. Public and verified evaluation conditions also need separate attention.","supported_claims":["The benchmark assesses inference of rules from worked grid examples and exact completion of new grids.","Human puzzle-solving results informed selection of test sets with similar human difficulty.","Official scoring averages input success within each problem, then averages problem scores."],"documented_problems":["Nearly correct grids receive no credit.","The software's fractional problem score differs from the dataset description's use of fully solved.","Documented corrections are not accompanied by recalculation of every affected AI score."],"missing_information":["Repeated-run variation and systematic sensitivity to presentation or instructions.","Evidence linking scores to performance outside grid problems.","Complete validation of the marking system and inspection of the full results archive."],"reinterpretations":["A score describes performance under the specified test conditions, rather than establishing general intelligence.","Human difficulty matching does not establish stability of AI scores.","A fractional problem score does not mean that the whole problem was fully solved."],"closing_note":"Some items combine several conditions, making partial evidence difficult to classify. Testing occurred should be distinguished from comprehensive validation; absent studies should remain Not sure."},{"benchmark":"designqa","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, its 1,451 question-answer pairs and public scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering-document abilities, tested AI systems and intended score comparisons are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task groups, supplied rules or images and text or yes/no responses are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions and settings are described, but historical settings and inputs are not fully linked to every result."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Text similarity, yes/no credit and equal weighting of the six groups are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors link the tasks to parts of engineers' work with rules and designs."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Real engineering materials justify practical relevance, but one rulebook and uneven groups limit coverage."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and more limited checks of some explanations."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six groups cover several relevant tasks, but one rulebook and limited task types restrict the claimed ability coverage."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Some marks reflect correct decisions, but wording, formatting and incomplete reference answers can affect credit."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is described, but evidence supporting that weighting or distinct skill interpretations is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Small marking-test files and examination of scoring problems show some testing; comprehensive accuracy and consistency remain unestablished."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AI systems provide comparisons, but no human-engineer baseline is reported."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five runs used different passage sets, so they do not isolate variation under identical conditions."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors tested changes to passages, dimension labels, scale bars and highlighted images."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage-set variation is examined for one AI, but uncertainty information is insufficient for small differences in the main comparisons."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting and retrieval influences were examined, but shortcut testing was incomplete; some drawings all have yes answers."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure were considered, but systematic overlap checks and a protected test set were not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear rules on training on the questions and repeated submissions were unavailable in the reviewed sources."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No supplied evidence shows that scores predict performance on other technical documents or engineering projects."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Information-supply differences are described, but some systems receive the full rulebook and others retrieved passages."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public questions, code, instructions and some responses support inspection, but do not fully reproduce every reported result."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The reviewer did not find a licence file or complete responsible-reuse rules; their availability elsewhere remains unknown."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but no clear record explains their effects on scores."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges scope and marking limits, while broader competence claims and fine rankings require more evidence."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire usefully separates engineering relevance, marking quality and generalization. Some items combine documentation with validation: described weighting does not establish its validity, and limited marking tests establish that testing occurred without establishing comprehensive reliability.","supported_claims":["DesignQA examines six kinds of tasks involving Formula SAE rules and vehicle materials.","The authors tested effects of changes to supplied passages and visual information.","Results reflect both the AI and the information supplied to it."],"documented_problems":["Formatting differences and valid rules absent from reference answers can affect marks.","Question groups range from 1,192 individual-rule questions to 16 performance questions, while receiving equal overall weight.","All described scale-bar drawings comply, allowing an always-yes response to earn their yes/no credit.","One released answer file has fewer rows than the corresponding question count in the paper."],"missing_information":["Identical-condition repeated testing and adequate uncertainty information for close model comparisons.","Comprehensive marking validation and remaining reference-answer error rates.","Complete historical inputs and software linked to every result.","Clear training, submission, licensing and responsible-reuse rules in the inspected materials.","Evidence of transfer to other documents or engineering projects."],"reinterpretations":["Scores describe performance on these tasks with the supplied information, rather than established general engineering competence.","Variation across different passage sets is not identical-condition repeated testing.","The always-yes opportunity does not establish that any tested AI used that strategy.","Missing reuse documentation does not establish that reuse is prohibited."],"closing_note":"Items about tested marking can be answered Yes despite limited validation. Combined conditions concerning uncertainty, fairness and documentation can make Partly versus Not sure unclear; unavailable evidence should not be treated as a demonstrated failure."}]}
